digest.component_or_area: Compaction subsystem - event store folding and scheduling
propositions: Compaction was removed from the close path due to a P0 lock hold, leaving stores with no standing compaction trigger.
Two separate triggers are needed: a scheduled 6-hourly CI sweep for amortized work, and an operation-linked fallback that works with no CI and no local cron.

The sweep's selection must use two arms to avoid both one-time backfill behavior and churn: backfill tickets lacking snapshots with foldable events, and re-fold already-snapshotted tickets whose foldable count exceeds the threshold.
Reporting must count only folds that actually write a new SNAPSHOT artifact, not every rc==0 return which cannot distinguish successful folds from no-ops.

The operation-linked trigger spawns a detached worker only if a just-closed ticket is foldable or the last sweep timestamp exceeds a configured staleness interval, with advisory locking to prevent concurrent compactors.

Git history walks in _build_authorship_ledger run per-ticket inside the store write lock, replicating bug 7084 at scale; they must be hoisted outside the lock and amortized with a single build_introducing_commit_map call per sweep.
